analysis:
Permission allow rule "Edit(*)" lets Edit run without asking only in the working directories. "Edit" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat "Edit(*)" as "Edit", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
Permission allow rule "Write(*)" lets Write run without asking only in the working directories. "Write" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat "Write(*)" as "Write", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
Permission allow rule "Read(*)" adds nothing to Read's default, which already runs without asking in the working directories. "Read" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat "Read(*)" as "Read", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
Permission allow rule "Glob(*)" adds nothing to Glob's default, which already runs without asking in the working directories. "Glob" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat "Glob(*)" as "Glob", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
Permission allow rule "Grep(*)" adds nothing to Grep's default, which already runs without asking in the working directories. "Grep" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat "Grep(*)" as "Grep", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
Permission allow rule "NotebookEdit(*)" lets NotebookEdit run without asking only in the working directories. "NotebookEdit" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat "NotebookEdit(*)" as "NotebookEdit", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
【一句總評】
量還很小，談不上趨勢：近 7 天曝光 15、點擊 6，前週點擊是 0。昨天站內 33 次造訪、27 次文章瀏覽，流量穩定。

【需要注意】
6 次點擊有 2 次來自 fb.yanchen.app，另一個子網域也在分這個站的搜尋流量。查詢資料幾乎是空的，7 天只露出「陳彥彤」1 筆，看不出大家是搜什麼進來的。28 天裡 node port 排第 9，最接近第一頁；k8s nodeport 和 service nodeport 卻掉到 74 和 99，同一個主題的排名差很多。

【今天可以做】
在 GSC 成效報表篩查詢「node port」，看是哪一頁拿到第 9 名。把「NodePort」放進那頁的 title 和一個 H2，再手動 Request Indexing。
